separate_design_system_evidence.cross_template_evidence: Contains system artifacts for deck, email, form, landing, newsletter, and poster.

design_template_groups.evidence_basis: Physical package inventory and references in actual SKILL.md files: framework-candidate group has template/runtime/schema support beyond a single example; web-prototype taste entries contain only skill+example and explicitly describe visual taste; 32 html-ppt-zhangzara entries carry template.json plus example/license but reuse the html-ppt deck master; 13 html-ppt entries explicitly route to the master. Remaining group lacks evidence of an independent reusable scaffold and is retained as skill/example pending deeper semantic review.

boundary_decisions: Treat template as reusable content/code framework with SKILL.md, seed/code, examples, and support files.
Treat design system as independent asset with manifest.json, DESIGN.md, and tokens.css.
Treat visual taste variants as design-system presets/examples, not new template identities unless they change reusable structure or behavior.
Do not count image generation, research, or brand extraction task Skills as templates solely because they contain SKILL.md.
Do not count the standalone CSS perspective device showcase as evidence of a reusable 3D framework.
No broad migration of 114 design-template entries is supported by this audit.
